name: Anti-Mage
flavor: “Magic shall not prevail!”

name: Abaddon, the Lord of Avernus
flavor: “You have called death upon yourself.”

name: Razzil Darkbrew, the Alchemist
flavor: “Easy now, this stuff is explosive!”

name: Kaldr, the Ancient Apparition
flavor: “One day, ice will cover these lands, and it will be as if this war never happened.”

name: Zet, the Arc Warden
flavor: “Matter has been split from its intended form. These must be made to unite.”

name: Roshan the Immortal
rules: When Roshan enters, any number of target creatures you control each deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don’t control.
flavor: Roshan’s punishment for killing a shopkeeper is to be slain and reborn for an eternity by the Radiant and Dire alike.

name: Mogul Khan, the Axe
flavor: “You fought badly—died worse.”

name: Atropos, the Bane
flavor: “The rebirth of my dream means the end of a myriad others.”

name: Jin'zakk, the Batrider
flavor: “Roasted, toasted and burned to a crisp.”

name: Radiant Melee Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Radiant Ranged Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Black Hole
flavor: “Stare into the abyss.” — Enigma, the Consumer of Worlds

name: Dire Melee Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Dire Ranged Creep
rules: Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)

name: Boots of Speed
flavor: Fleet footwear, increasing movement.

name: Finger of Death
flavor: “When you get to Hell, tell them I sent you.” — Lion, the Demon Witch

name: Stifling Dagger
flavor: “Where falls my shadow, fells my blade.”  — Mortred, the Phantom Assassin

name: Roshan’s Pit
flavor: The depths of Roshan’s lair are unable to dampen the resounding quake of his emergence.

name: Kobold Thief
rules: When this creature dies, create a Treasure token.

name: Glyph of Fortification
rules: Permanents you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
flavor: A powerful glyph, it makes allies impervious to all damage for some time.

name: Observer Ward
flavor: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.

name: Blink Dagger
flavor: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.

name: Sentry Ward
flavor: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

name: Karroch, the Beastmaster
flavor: “Welcome to the food chain.”

name: Strygwyr, the Bloodseeker
flavor: “For the Flayed Twins, I seek blood.”

name: Gondar, the Bounty Hunter
flavor: “It was just business before. Now it’s personal.”

name: Mangix, the Brewmaster
flavor: “Drink and be bleary, for tomorrow we die!”

name: Nether Ward
flavor: While at the lamasery for the Arts of Oblivion, Pugna learned to dominate his classmates with a simple ward charged with Nether magic.

name: Rigwarl, the Bristleback
flavor: “More where that came from, sunshine.”

name: Black Arachnia, the Broodmother
flavor: “You’re not afraid of spiders, are you?”

name: Bradwarden, the Centaur Warrunner
flavor: “These proving grounds shall be littered with the dead.”

name: Chaos Knight
flavor: “Fall to your knees and lament.”

name: Chen, the Holy Knight
flavor: “I have left the dark desert of my past to walk now in the light of Obelis.”

name: Magebane’s Mirror
rules: Counter target spell or ability that targets a legendary creature you control. If a spell or ability is countered this way, you may copy it and you may choose new targets for the copy.
flavor: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

name: Clinkz, the Bone Fletcher
flavor: “Fire grows hungrier the more it’s fed.”

name: Rattletrap, the Clockwerk
flavor: “I’ve a mind like a steel trap, and the physique to go with it!”

name: Rylai, the Crystal Maiden
flavor: “Guess you didn’t know a little game of freeze tag could turn lethal.”

name: Ish'Kafel, the Dark Seer
rules: When Ish’Kafel enters, choose an opponent. For each creature they control, create a token that’s a copy of that creature.
flavor: “Your life, much like your head, lacked a point.”

name: Mireska, the Dark Willow
flavor: “A little mischief never killed anyone... well, you I guess.”

name: Valora, the Dawnbreaker
flavor: “My powers, like my life, were given to me. The will to wield them justly I found on my own.”

name: Aghanim’s Sceptre
flavor: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

name: Dazzle, the Shadow Priest
flavor: “Where my shadow falls, there falls my foe.”

name: Deafening Blast
flavor: “I am a beacon of knowledge blazing out across a black sea of ignorance.” — Carl, the Invoker

name: Grimstroke
flavor: “The battlefield is merely a canvas, waiting for my brush.”

name: Krobelus, the Death Prophet
flavor: “What I’ve seen goes far beyond death.”

name: Disruptor, the Stormcrafter
flavor: “Feeling under the weather?”

name: Lucifer, the Doom
flavor: “I am the midnight of your soul.”

name: Doom
rules: Choose target creature an opponent controls. It loses all abilities until end of turn. Destroy it.
flavor: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, Doom is sure to follow.

name: Davion, the Dragon Knight
flavor: “The dragon Slyrak sleeps within this armor, and the knight within the Dragon waits. Beware you do not wake them both.”

name: Kaolin, the Earth Spirit
flavor: “Through conflict, one’s nature is revealed.”

name: Echo Slam
flavor: “No one sees an earthquake coming.” — Raigor, the Earthshaker

name: Raigor, the Earthshaker
flavor: “There may be many earths, but there’s only one Earthshaker.”

name: Elder Titan, the Worldsmith
flavor: “What long ago I shattered must be rendered whole.

name: Astral Spirit
rules: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control for each creature your opponents control.
flavor: “My broken soul goes forth.” — Elder Titan, the Worldsmith

name: Xin, the Ember Spirit
flavor: “Balance in all things.”

name: Aiushtha, the Enchantress
flavor: “It’s a hop, skip and a jump!”

name: Enigma, Consumer of Worlds
flavor: “That which is fundamental cannot be destroyed.”

name: Darkterror, the Faceless Void
flavor: “Time is a river with many eddies. I have seen its head waters, and I have seen its currents reach the sea.”

name: Chronosphere
flavor: “I have seen the future; you’re not in it.” — Darkterror, the Faceless Void

name: Aurel, the Gyrocopter
flavor: “You remind me of my old boss. Rot in Hell!”

name: Hoodwink
flavor: “You ever hear the one about the tortoise and the hare and the squirrel that shot ‘em both?”

name: Chilling Touch
rules: Tap up to two target creatures you don’t control. Then, draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.
flavor: The Ancient Apparition’s eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

name: Huskar, the Sacred Warrior
flavor: “Great honors await you in the Nothl Realm.”

name: Carl, the Invoker
flavor: “Did I hear a squeak?”

name: Dragon Tail
flavor: Davion’s combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

name: Timber Chain
flavor: “I’m not a lumberjack. This. This is personal. — Rizzrack, the Timbersaw

name: Kraken Shell
flavor: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.

name: Magic Wand
flavor: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

name: Io, the Wisp
flavor: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.

name: Overcharge
flavor: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.

name: Arena of Blood
flavor: “DADADA DA DA DA-DA-DA!” — Mars, the First Son of Heaven

name: Shackleshot
flavor: “I now pronounce you man and tree.” — Lyralei, the Windranger

name: Rot
flavor: “Fill your lungs up.” — Pudge, the Butcher

name: Open Wounds
flavor: Sometimes, the first slash cuts the deepest

name: Naix, the Lifestealer
flavor: “Your life, stolen right out from under you.”

name: Tango
flavor: Forage to survive on the battlefield.

name: Faerie Fire
flavor: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.

name: Enchanted Mango
flavor: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.

name: Town Portal Scroll
flavor: What a hero truly needs.

name: Reincarnation
flavor: “Death has no grip on me.” — Ostarion, the Wraith King

name: Ostarion, the Wraith King
flavor: “Was that some sort of misguided tribute?”

name: Claymore
flavor: A sword that can cut through armor, it’s a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.

name: Gem of True Sight
flavor: Not one thrall creature of the depths, nor spirit bound in drowning’s keep, nor Maelrawn the Tentacular, shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.

name: Presence of the Dark Lord
flavor: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one’s soul.

name: Soul Ring
flavor: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

name: Hand of Midas
rules: T, Sacrifice Hand of Midas: Destroy target nonlegendary creature. You create X treasure tokens, where X is that creature’s mana value.
flavor: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner’s pockets.

name: Moon Shard
flavor: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.

name: Urn of Shadows
flavor: Contains the ashes of powerful demons—invigorating to some, and deadly to most.

name: Desolator
flavor: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.

name: Mekansm
flavor: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

name: Drums of Endurance
flavor: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

name: Meepo, the Geomancer
flavor: “I guess size ain’t everything, eh?”

name: Jakiro, the Twin Head Dragon
flavor: “Tis an honor to die by dragons.”

name: Yurnero, the Juggernaut
flavor: “There’s a fine line between bravery and stupidity.”

name: Ezalor, the Keeper of the Light
flavor: “I’ll forego green girdles and questing beasts, for all such knightly trifles pale before the light.”

name: Kunkka, the Admiral
flavor: “This’ll trim your sails!”

name: Fiend’s Grip
flavor: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.

name: Tresdin, the Legion Commander
flavor: “I’ve come to put an end to hope.”

name: Leshrac, the Tormented Soul
flavor: “Your desolation and the world’s are one.”

name: Ethreain, the Lich
flavor: “I number you among the dead.”

name: Lina, the Slayer
rules: Flying, prowess, prowess (Each instance of prowess triggers separately)
flavor: “Burn, baby, burn.”

name: Lion, the Demon Witch
flavor: “I’ve been to Hell and back, and back to Hell…and back.”

name: Sylla, the Lone Druid
flavor: ‘Nature chose her guardian well.”

name: Luna, the Moon Rider
flavor: “By Nightsilver!”

name: Banehallow, the Lycan
flavor: “I am the alpha wolf.”

name: Puck, the Faerie Dragon
flavor: “Stay and amuse me!”

name: Magnus, the Magnoceros
flavor: “You must have mistaken my purpose…to flatten you!”

name: Marci
flavor: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

name: Mars, the First Son of Heaven
flavor: “Let the name Mars ring across the battlefield, and bear witness to my enemy’s flight.”

name: Medusa, the Gorgon
flavor: “Never come between a Gorgon and her sisters”

name: Mirana of Nightsilver
flavor: “The stars are in alignment, and our victory is certain.”

name: Wukong, the Monkey King
flavor: “My next great challenge will be your last.”

name: Morphling
flavor: “You’re washed up!”

name: Muerta
flavor: “I promise you a quick death. The eternity of torment waiting for you in the afterlife might take a bit longer.”

name: Slithice, the Naga Siren
flavor: “From this sleep you will not wake.”

name: Tormentor
rules: When Tormentor enters, it deals 4 damage divided randomly among creatures you control.
flavor: Innocuous as first, the Divine Sentinel lashes out at anyone who dares draw near.

name: Nature’s Grasp
rules: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn. You may search your library for a basic land card and put it on to the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
flavor: “I would like nothing more than to plant myself in the sunshine, next to a cool stream.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Nature’s Prophet
flavor: “Ah, the sun in my leaves.”

name: Rotund'jere, Necrophos
flavor: “You become feast for the flesh flies.”

name: Reaper’s Scythe
rules: Destroy target creature with toughness less than its base toughness.
flavor: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of the Necrophos’ plague magic.

name: Balanar, the Night Stalker
flavor: “I’m the beast of bedtime tales.”

name: Dark Ascension
flavor: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.

name: Nyx Assassin
flavor: “Your thoughts betray you.”

name: Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi
flavor: “Running’s not as fun as hitting. Not one bit fun!”

name: Purist Thunderwrath, the Omniknight
flavor: “Let this be the last crusade. Let me find peace.”

name: Nerif, the Oracle
flavor: “Like a promise, you were made to be broken.”

name: Buyback
flavor: “Wait, you don’t have buyback?” — Famous last words

name: Harbinger, Outworld Destroyer
flavor: “My wings beat with the rhythms of eternity.”

name: Astral Imprisonment
flavor: “Their sanity I’ll shatter, their dreams of conquest I’ll destroy.” — Harbinger, the Outworld Destroyer

name: Donté Panlin, the Pangolier
flavor: “Where the finest warriors alive have gathered for battle, of course you can expect to find me.”

name: Mortred, the Phantom Assassin
rules: Double strike, hexproof, menace
flavor: “Even in death, you’ll not see beyond the Phantom Veil.”

name: Azwraith, the Phantom Lancer
flavor: “We outnumbered you. We outnumber them all!”

name: Phoenix
flavor: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.

name: Primal Beast
flavor: The Beast’s single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

name: Pudge, the Butcher
flavor: “Have I got juice on me chins?”

name: Pugna
flavor: “I’ll take that life if you’re not using it, he he he.”

name: Akasha, the Queen of Pain
flavor: “Long live your Queen!”

name: Razor, the Lightning Revenant
flavor: “I bring my lightning whip not to punish souls, but only to hasten them toward the inevitable exit.”

name: Riki, the Stealth Assassin
flavor: “I speak softly, but carry a sharp knife.”

name: Rubick, the Grand Magus
flavor: “Such fascinating energies!”

name: Crixalis, the Sand King
flavor: “Oh Desert Djinn who forged my living carapace, eternally the sand will praise your name!”

name: Shadow Demon
rules: 4RR, T: Exile target creature until end of turn. Create two token copies of the exiled creature, except they’re not legendary if that creature is legendary. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
flavor: “Your soul will make a fine minion!”

name: Nevermore, the Shadow Fiend
flavor: “I’ll leave you a couple pennies for your eyes.”

name: Rhasta, the Shadow Shaman
rules: When Rhasta enters, target creature loses all abilities and becomes a 0/1 white Chicken creature for as long as you control Rhasta.
flavor: “A fine form for you!”

name: Nortrom, the Silencer
flavor: “Shhh!”

name: Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage
flavor: “I am a tool of the greater good. What does that make you?”

name: Slardar, Slithereen Guard
flavor: “Can’t fathom why you thought you’d survive.”

name: Slark, the Nightcrawler
flavor: “If I’d known I’d end up here, I’d have stayed in Dark Reef Prison.”

name: Beatrix and Mortimer
rules: At the beginning of combat on your turn, Beatrix and Mortimer gets +2/+0 and has double strike until end of turn.
flavor: “I’m Beadie. N’ this here’s Mortimer. Nothing fancy. Just here to kill some time and if we can manage, some people.”

name: Kardel Sharpeye, the Sniper
flavor: “As long as there are two heroes left on the battlefield, someone is gonna want someone dead.”

name: Mercurial, the Spectre
flavor: “Who cannot endure, is entombed.”

name: Barathrum, the Spirit Breaker
flavor: “Mine is the anvil on which your spirit broke.”

name: Raijin, the Storm Spirit
flavor: “Told you a storm was coming!”

name: Sven, the Rogue Knight
flavor: “Rogue Knight claims another.”

name: Inai, the Void Spirit
flavor: “I abhor the blindness of the mortal plane.”

name: Squee, Spleen, and Spoon, the Techies
rules: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a colorless artifact token named Remote Mine with “T, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 2 damage to target attacking creature.”
flavor: “Techies Demolitions! We put the tech in tech-nically we meant to do that.”

name: Lanaya, the Templar Assassin
flavor: “Your death was a secret I can no longer hide.”

name: Terrorblade, Demon Marauder
flavor: “The self-righteous shall choke on their sanctimony.”

name: Leviathan, the Tidehunter
flavor: “I’m hungry enough to eat a manta ray.”

name: Rizzrack, the Timbersaw
flavor: “I cut you, and I split you, and I killed you! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!”

name: Boush, the Tinker
flavor: “You can keep your magic, I have laser beams!”

name: Tiny, the Stone Giant
flavor: “Sticks and stones will break their bones!”

name: Rooftrellen, Treant Protector
flavor: “Where the path branched, you chose unwisely.”

name: Jah'rakal, the Troll Warlord
flavor: “All hail the Lord of Trolls.”

name: Ymir, the Tusk
flavor: “I say we should trade blows!”

name: Vrogros, the Underlord
flavor: “I will scorch this land and its people will come to fear a new master!”

name: Undying, the Almighty Dirge
flavor: “I bring the song of death.”

name: Ulfsaar, the Ursa Warrior
flavor: “Come not near the darkwoods where my kindred sleep.”

name: Shendelzare, Vengeful Spirit
rules: When Shendelzare dies, return it to the battlefield tapped with no abilities.
flavor: “By the bloody pinions of Avilliva!”

name: Lesale Deathbringer, the Venomancer
flavor: “Have I tainted the well of our discourse?”

name: Viper, the Netherdrake
flavor: “Burns…doesn’t it?”

name: Visage, the Form of Necro'lic
flavor: “I perceive beyond this realm.”

name: Demnok Lannik, the Warlock
rules: When Demnok enters, create an X/X red and black Demon Golem creature token with trample and haste.
flavor: “You’re but a blot in the Black Grimoire.”

name: Skitskurr, the Weaver
flavor: “To the loom with you, to be rewoven.”

name: Lyralei, the Windranger
flavor: “If you weren’t so damned dead, I’d shoot you again.”

name: Auroth, the Winter Wyvern
flavor: “Let them all fall still beneath my shadow!”

name: Heat Seeking Missiles
flavor: “Initializing in… 3..2..1!” — Boush, the Tinker

name: Zharvakko, the Witch Doctor
flavor: “Malpractice makes perfect.”

name: Zeus, the Lord of Heaven
flavor: “For this I gave up immortality?”

name: Kobold Foreman
rules: Whenever you sacrifice a nonland permanent, add one mana of any color to your mana pool.

name: Mud Golem
rules: When this creature dies, create two 1/1 white Golem creature tokens.

name: Centaur Courser
rules: Creatures you control have ward 1.

name: Dark Troll Summoner
rules: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

name: Warpine Raider
rules: When this creature enters, search your library for a Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

name: Ice Golem
rules: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls. You may put a stun counter on it.

name: Phase Boots
flavor: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

name: Tranquil Boots
flavor: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.

name: Power Treads
flavor: A pair of tough-skinned boots that change to meet the demands of the wearer.

name: Linken’s Sphere
flavor: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.

name: Refresher Orb
rules: T, Exile Refresher Orb: Take an extra turn after this one.
flavor: A powerful artifact created for an unknown wizard, it’s appearance is inert to the naked eye.

name: Manta Style
flavor: An axe made of reflective materials that causes confusion amongst enemy ranks.

name: Blade Mail
flavor: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.

name: Aeon Disk
flavor: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.

name: Holy Locket
flavor: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.

name: Dust of Appearance
flavor: One may hide visage, but never volume.

name: Infused Raindrop
flavor: Elemental protection from magical assaults.

name: Orb of Corrosion
flavor: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist’s orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.

name: Aether Lens
flavor: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.

name: Dagon
flavor: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

name: Eul’s Scepter
flavor: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.

name: Glimmer Cape
flavor: The stolen cape of a master illusionist.

name: Scythe of Vyse
rules: T: Target creature an opponent controls becomes a 0/1 blue Boar creature token until this artifact leaves the battlefield.
flavor: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

name: Overclocking
flavor: “I am a can of whoop-ass!” — Rattletrap, the Clockwerk

name: Hammer of Purity
flavor: An enchanted hammer forged of metals discovered in the ruins of a village destroyed by a great star storm.

name: Butterfly
flavor: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

name: Radiance
rules: Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent’s control, Radiance deals 1 damage to that creature’s controller and that creature becomes tapped.
flavor: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

name: Khanda
flavor: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.

name: Cheese
flavor: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.

name: Acorn Shot
flavor: “Caught ya in your stubbies did we?” — Hoodwink

name: Black King Bar
flavor: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.

name: Noxious Plague
flavor: “Keep your enemies close, and your antidotes closer.” — Lesale Deathbringer, the Venomancer

name: Unleash
flavor: Not many understand Marci’s whistles, but everyone knows which whistle means its time to turn and run.

name: Animal Courier
flavor: “Whaddya mean we should kill ‘im, lookit how cute he is! OH GOD HE’S GOT A DAGON!” — Aggron, the Ogre Magi

name: Radiant Tower
flavor: The light emitting from the Radiant Tower draws its creeps ever forward.

name: Dire Tower
flavor: If the mere appearance of the Dire Tower isn’t dissuading enough on its own, there are always the cannons.

name: Spell Steal
flavor: “Yoink.” — Rubick, the Grand Magus

name: Chaos Meteor
flavor: “Exort, Wex, Exort!” — Carl, the Invoker

name: Thundergod’s Wrath
flavor: “You can’t run from heaven.” — Zeus, the Lord of Heaven

name: Wrath of Nature
flavor: “New life will make its home amongst your bones.” — Nature’s Prophet

name: Druud, Host of Stryders
flavor: In a single night their refuge became a killing floor.

name: Radiant Fountain
flavor: Any encroaching darkness is quickly is purified with a brilliant, bright light.

name: Hazhadal Barrens
flavor: Beneath its peat lay a the remnants of the siege of Valhessi.

name: Shadeshore
flavor: Its deceptively beautiful carnivorous mangroves digest flesh with ease.

name: Shrine to Elune
flavor: The Moon Goddess is said to reveal herself at her shrine during a full moon.

name: Icewrack
flavor: “You move like a Blueheart Glacier!” — Rylai, the Crystal Maiden.

name: Stonehall
flavor: Vrogos’ forces wreaked unfathomed destruction on Stonehall, but its scars now stand as a testament to its enduring courage.

name: Wailing Mountains
flavor: Many have set out to trace their course—none have returned to chart their end.

name: Mount Joerlack
flavor: Untamed wilderness—unmatched danger.

name: Thorny Wastes
flavor: The home of Black Arachnia, few dare enter her domain.

name: Radiant Siege Wagon
flavor: A Radiant Siege Engine has been known to singlehandedly topple an unguarded Dire Tower.

name: Dire Siege Wagon
flavor: A lone Dire siege engine has been known to single-handedly topple an unguarded Radiant Tower.

name: Smoke Screen
flavor: “Here’s smoke in your eyes!” — Riki, the Stealth Assassin

name: Mystic Flare
flavor: “Those who tangle with the Skywrath risk a fall from starry heights.” — Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage

name: The Shop
flavor: “Excellent choice. I’ll just wrap it up, shall I?” — The Shopkeeper

name: Inner Colonnade
flavor: Within it’s walls, the Vigil Knights of the Flameguard stand watch over the Holy Flame.

name: Last Word
flavor: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.

name: Admiral’s Call
rules: Creatures you control gain flying and become Spirits in addition to their other types. Prevent all damage that would reduce a creature’s toughness to 0 this turn.
flavor: The final ship of the Claddish Navy can be called upon by Kunkka to assist him in battle, its haunting hymn conscripting his allies into its phantom crew.

name: Ignis Fatuus
flavor: “I was the light at the end of your tunnel.” — Ezalor, Keeper of the Light

name: Overpower
rules: Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power. Then, that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
flavor: “A loss so small, the world will hardly notice.” — Ulfsaar, the Ursa Warrior

name: Guardian Angel
flavor: “The wings of omniscience enwrap us.” — Purist Thunderwrath, the Omniknight

name: Omexe, the Grand Arena
flavor: “The Omexe Arena is where I made a name for myself. I was its champion, and no one was my equal.” — Bradwarden, the Centaur Warrunner

name: Maledict
flavor: “He’s about to pop!” — Zharvakko, the Witch Doctor

name: Mirror Image
flavor: “Oh, look, it’s me.” — Slithice, the Naga Siren

name: Wukong’s Command
flavor: “Leave it to me. Lots and lots of me.” — Sun Wukong, the Monkey King

name: Alfredo
rules: Trample

name: Treasure
rules: T, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color to your mana pool.

rules: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a token that’s a copy of this creature.

name: Ape
rules: Vigilance

name: Map
rules: 1, T, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.

name: Hawk
rules: Flying

rules: Infect (This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.)

name: Spider
rules: Deathtouch

name: Ghastly Aerie
flavor: “From the Ghastly Eyrie I can see to the ends of the world, and from this vantage point I declare with utter certainty that this one is in the bag!” — Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage

name: Ogoldi Slave Pen
flavor: The Red Mist army relies on a system of cruelty and torture to supply their forces against the demonic warlord.

name: Cathedral of Rumusque
flavor: Within its marble, the grand priestess Crella forged the Chains of Abscession to bind the servants of the Dead God.

name: Tyler Estate
flavor: Inmates are experimented on at the Estate, with items such as the Witchbane being developed as a result.

name: Oroyo Expanse
flavor: The home of Mangix is rich in culture—and even richer in alcohol.

name: Dark Reef
flavor: Only but one is known to have bypassed the Prison’s defenses.

name: Clarity
flavor: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.

name: Healing Salve
flavor: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.

name: Sunder
flavor: “Stolen fruit is ever sweetest.” — Terrorblade, the Demon Marauder

name: Exorcism
flavor: “Go, my sweet sisters, go!” — Krobelus, the Death Prophet

name: Cogliostro, the Ringmaster
flavor: “I am a showman. The rest of you are the circus.”

name: Kez
flavor: “My sword, my beak, and myself! Three sharpest things in this forest.”

name: Conjured Image
rules: Lifelink

name: Demon Golem
rules: Trample, haste

name: Incapacitating Bite
rules: Exile target creature. Its controller reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player exiles that card.
flavor: Paralytic toxins come from Black Arachnia’s fangs, causing a slow and painful death to those who intrude on her webs.

name: Remote Mine
rules: T, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals 2 damage to target attacking creature.

name: Reality Rift
rules: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. Put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
flavor: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.

name: Double Edge
flavor: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden’s vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.

name: Sinister Gaze
rules: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile it. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
flavor: “For the greater good—mine!” — Ethreain, the Lich

name: Ring of Tarasque
flavor: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer’s fortitude.

name: Pipe of Insight
flavor: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

name: Nature’s Attendants
flavor: Whimsical spirits of the woods possess a healing power that is quite subtle, but gains strength in numbers.

name: Ice Path
flavor: Jakiro’s cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.

name: Nether Strike
flavor: Barathrum’s unyielding focus forms a pocket of planar convergence from which not even the most powerful arcane energies can escape.

name: Primal Roar
flavor: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

name: Firesnap Cookie
flavor: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie’s baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.

name: Powershot
rules: Destroy target attacking or blocking creature.
flavor: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to flight incoming attacks.

name: Penitence
rules: Target attacking creature deals damage to itself equal to its power.
flavor: “The recusant shall pay!” — Chen, the Holy Knight

name: Spirit Link
flavor: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear’s claws.

name: Enchant Remnant
flavor: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.

name: Sprint
flavor: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.

name: Corrosive Skin
flavor: “You twitch like a snake-bitten mouse”. — Viper, the Nether Drake

name: Dark Pact
flavor: I call darkness from the deep!” — Slark, the Nightcrawler

name: Death Pact
flavor: “I’ve already paid my pound of flesh.” — Clinkz, the Bone Fletcher

name: Phantasm Illusion
rules: First strike

name: Traxex, the Drow Ranger
flavor: “I’ll cut a notch with your name on it!”

name: Aphotic Shield
flavor: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.

name: Spark Wraith
flavor: “Let no foe come near” — Zet, the Arc Warden

name: Whirling Axes
flavor: “I peel back your uglies.” — Jah’rakal, the Troll Warlord

name: Gush
flavor: “Look what the tide washed in.” — Leviathan, the Tidehunter

name: Ignite
flavor: “And another... and another!” — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

name: Take Aim
rules: The next time a source you control would deal damage to target creature or player, it deals double that amount instead.
flavor: “Thanks for standing still, wanker!” — Kardel Sharpeye, the Sniper

name: Shockwave
rules: Shockwave deals damage equal to target creature’s power to target creature you don’t control. When the creature you don’t control dies this turn, draw a card.
flavor: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.

name: Decay
rules: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature you don’t control. Then, put four +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
flavor: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.

name: Helm of the Dominator
flavor: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.

name: Ion Shell
flavor: “If your enemy is equal, prepare for him. If greater, elude him. If weaker, crush him.” — Ish’Kafel, the Dark Seer

name: Culling Blade
flavor: “You get nothing. Good day, sir!” — Mogul Khan, the Axe

name: Provocative Comment
flavor: “You want some of this, son, you want it?” — Rigwarl, the Bristleback

name: Lightning Bolt
rules: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
flavor: “Your prayer, answered.” — Zeus, the Lord of Heaven

name: Smoke of Deceit
flavor: The charlatan wizard Myrddin’s only true contribution to the arcane arts.

name: Arc Lightning
rules: Arc Lightning deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
flavor: “Ha ha ha ha ha. Well what did you expect?” — Zeus, the Lord of Heaven

name: Obvious Distraction
flavor: Meepo’s proficiency for diversion is bested only by his clumsiness.

name: Living Armor
flavor: “Come into my shade.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Fountain of Rejuvenation
flavor: Basking in the Fountain is a short respite from the chaos of battle.

name: Walrus PUNCH!
rules: Exile target blocking creature. Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn.
flavor: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

name: Bramble Maze
rules: Whenever a creature attacks you, put a -1/-1 counter on it.
flavor: “You want me, come get me...” — Mireska, the Dark Willow

name: Shadow Walk
flavor: “You can’t fight what you can’t see.” — Gondar, the Bounty Hunter

name: Tandem Takedown
rules: Up to two target creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. They each deal damage equal to their power to another target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
flavor: “Ready? One... Two... Three!” — Nattea, Centaur Courser

name: Light Strike Array
rules: Light Strike Array deals 5 damage to each opponent. Creatures those players control can’t block this turn.
flavor: “One little spark and before you know it, the whole world is burning.” — Lina, the Slayer

name: Enchant
flavor: “Charmed, I’m sure!” —  Aiushtha, the Enchantress

name: Infernal Blade
flavor: “I stoke the furnace with your corpse.” — Lucifer, the Doom

name: Pounce
rules: Target creature you control fights target creature you don’t control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.

name: Refraction
flavor: “Another scale of ignorance shed.” — Lanaya, the Templar Assassin

name: Largo
flavor: “Hoo easy, mate. I’m gonna write a killer song about this.”

name: Starfall
flavor: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.

name: Vale of Augury
flavor: Rootfallen and the Ent live in the mountains beyond the Vale, where the eldritch soil keeps them nourished.

name: Omexe Ambush
flavor: The Omexe archers are renowned for their ability to track targets through the Jungle with ease.

name: Sprout Treant
flavor: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.

name: Gust
flavor: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

name: Conscript

flavor: The Bronze Legion does not discriminate against any prisoners based on their race or kin, provided they know how to fight.

name: Roam the Jungle
flavor: To some, the Radiant Jungle is a battlefield, to others, it is home.

name: Stern Rebuttal
rules: Exile target instant or sorcery spell. Draw a card.
flavor: “I cast Magic aside” — Anti-Mage

name: Slack Off
flavor: Oftentimes, thought Krang, the siege wagons seemed to load themselves.

name: Helping Hand
flavor: “I’ve got you!”

name: Ball of Creeps
flavor: Some say you can hear the sound of gold dropping as it rolls.

name: Protect the Young
rules: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 for each creature you control and gains indestructible until end of turn.
flavor: Thunderhide migration is always discernible by an impending quake.

name: Bronze Hoplite
rules: First strike

name: Covet
rules: Gain control of target artifact an opponent controls.
flavor: “When do I get a turn?” “You’ve already had a turn!”  — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

name: Coup de Grace
rules: Destroy target creature an opponent controls.

name: Doppleganger
rules: Exile target creature you control. Create a token that’s a copy of that creature, except it isn’t legendary if the exiled creature was legendary. Return the exiled creature to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step.
flavor: Dread Magus Vorn’s death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to blend with all spectrums of light.

name: Ravage
flavor: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

name: Dragon Slave
rules: Create a 4/4 red dragon elemental creature token with haste.
flavor: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.

name: Solar Guardian
flavor: Its much harder to hit someone with a sword with the sun in your eyes.

name: Overgrowth
flavor: “Thoughts cross my mind as the sun crosses the sky.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Corner
flavor: “It appears I’ve gotten myself into a pickle” — Kardel Sharpeye, the Sniper

name: Unyielding Spirit
rules: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each nonlegendary creature you control.
flavor: Under fire, outnumbered, and surrounded, Torq never gave up hope.

name: Finesse
rules: Exile target artifact. Draw a card.
flavor: “Nothing to it Rikko, I told you!”
